names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 iulie, «Sfânta Muceniță Golinduhia din Persia», with the rank words left off.
Her baptismal name, read out of the last line of doxologia.ro's life: «Sfânta Muceniță Maria, care mai înainte s-a numit Golinduhia».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Ιουλίου, «Αγία Γολινδούχ η Περσίδα που μετονομάστηκε Μαρία», with the rank word, the nationality and the clause about her new name left off.
The baptismal name, read out of the same line for 13 Ιουλίου: «η Περσίδα που μετονομάστηκε Μαρία», and out of the life page's «όταν βαπτίστηκε πήρε το όνομα Μαρία».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 12. јул ст. ст., „Св. мученица Голиндуха.“ — „Св.“ is not a rank and „мученица“ is the rank `types` already carries, so the bare forename is the whole form. **Her baptismal name Марија is not stored**: the body gives it, the heading does not, and §4 and §6 together make a stored form the heading’s and not the body’s. `foldchk.py` returns no holder and `sr-foldpred.mjs` predicts a new key with no other holder — had Марија been taken off the body it would have folded with a great many women, which is the second reason not to take it.

Name page 2448 is «Голиндуха (в крещении Мария) Персидская, исповедница»: the rank is stripped, and the parenthetical «в крещении Мария», in baptism Maria, is a clause about a second name and not part of this one, so it is recorded in the row note and not in the form. The folder already holds «Maria» as a Romanian and a Greek form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 июля ст. ст. — «Прав. Вероники Палестинской (I) Мц. Голиндухи , во св. Крещении Марии (591).»

attestations.note: The second woman of the day's third entry. Name page 2448 is «Голиндуха (в крещении Мария) Персидская, исповедница» — the Persia of the display name, the Maria this folder already stores as a Romanian and a Greek form, and a grade of `confessor` the `types` do not carry and which was NOT added, the Serbian row's own book calling her a martyr as this line does. THE YEARS DISAGREE AND `dates` IS UNCHANGED: the line closes «(591)» where the folder holds 587 off the Ohrid Prologue, read as its own figure. The reading life4224 was NOT opened and the day page prints no hymn under her name.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 iulie — «Sfânta Muceniță Golinduhia din Persia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Ιουλίου — «Αγία Γολινδούχ η Περσίδα που μετονομάστηκε Μαρία»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and it is plainly the same woman: the Persian renamed Mary at her baptism, which is what the folder's second recorded name form already says. She is the corpus's only Golinduhia. The Greek page adds the reigns — Khosrow of the Persians and Maurice of the Romans, which it brackets 582 to 602 — but no year of her own, so no `dates` object is proposed: the bracket is the reign of the emperor and not of her life, and the page gives eighteen years of her imprisonment without a start. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under her line.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 25.07.2026 (12. јул ст. ст.) — „Св. мученица Голиндуха.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, and **it lands a day before the two calendars that already keep her**: the Romanian and Greek rows stand on the 13 July and this book prints her on the 12th. The `serbian` row was `undocumented`, so it is written plainly on this book’s day and nothing of the other two is touched — §4 forbids moving a principal day — and the two days stand side by side in the life. The identification is not in doubt and the Greek calendar’s own heading makes it: saint.gr has «Αγία Γολινδούχ η Περσίδα που μετονομάστηκε Μαρία», the Persian woman renamed Maria, and this book says „На крштењу доби име Марија“, at her baptism she received the name Maria. One Persian woman, one second name, two consecutive days. **`dates` WRITTEN WHERE THE FOLDER HAD NONE.** `dates: null` before; this book ends „Најзад проповедајући веру праву мирно скончала близу града Нисивије, 587. год.“, so `death` is 587 to 587, display «587», basis traditional. A flat year into an empty field, which is exactly what the narrowing rule permits and does not touch. **The eighteen years in prison and the three years of her marriage are durations**, and nothing is reckoned back from 587 by either of them. `types` UNTOUCHED at `martyr`, which „мученица“ is — **and the body says she died in peace**, „мирно скончала“, after all her sufferings, so this folder is a martyr by the rank its calendars give it and not by its death, which is a thing worth recording and not a thing to correct: §10 reserves the reading and §5 gives the rank. No `locations`: Persia, Jerusalem and Nisibis are a narrative. No new `related` rows — the Persian magus she married, the angel who showed her the other world, and Severus whose heresy she refuted at Jerusalem are a husband, an angel and a heresiarch, and `syra-of-persia`, whom the folder already relates, is not named in this book at all. **WHAT IS NEW IS THE WHOLE MIDDLE OF THE LIFE.** The vision of an angel who showed her the other world, the torments of sinners and unbelievers and the joy of the righteous, after three years of marriage to a Persian magus; the life sentence to prison, and **eighteen years in it without wavering**; being thrown into a pit and saved by God, and set before a dreadful serpent that did not harm her; wicked youths sent to defile her, and **God making her invisible to their eyes**; many Persians coming to the faith of Christ in amazement at her suffering; and the visit to Jerusalem, where she refuted the heresy of Severus — which taught that the divinity in Christ suffered, on account of which they sang the Trisagion with the words «who wast crucified for us» added. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Mieluşeaua Ta, Iisuse, Golinduhia, strigă cu glas mare: pe Tine, Mirele meu, te iubesc și pe Tine căutându-Te mă chinuiesc și împreună mă răstignesc și împreună mă îngrop cu Botezul Tău; și pătimesc pentru Tine, ca să împărățesc întru Tine; și mor pentru tine, ca să viez pentru Tine; ci, ca o jertfă fără de prihană, primește-mă pe mine ceea ce cu dragoste mă jertfesc Ție. Pentru rugăciunile ei, ca un milostiv, mântuiește sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfintei Mucenițe Golinduhia din Persia», Glasul 4 — the common troparion of a woman martyr, printed here with her name

english.text: Your ewe-lamb Golinduhia cries out to You, Jesus, with a loud voice: You, my Bridegroom, I love, and seeking You I am in torment; I am crucified with You and buried with You in Your baptism; I suffer for You, that I may reign in You, and I die for You, that I may live in You. Receive me, then, as an unblemished sacrifice, who sacrifice myself to You in love. At her prayers, as the merciful One, save our souls.

death.note: The folder held no dates at all; neither doxologia nor saint.gr gave a year. The Охридски пролог for 12. јул ст. ст. ends „Најзад проповедајући веру праву мирно скончала близу града Нисивије, 587. год.“ The eighteen years in prison and the three years of her marriage are durations and nothing is reckoned from them.
